reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly supports the as-deposited coercivity and the 40-fold increase after RTA, but it does not mention chemical ordering, anisotropic lattice distortions, or the specific mechanism (magnetocrystalline anisotropy, domain wall pinning) for the FeCoNiMnCu film without Pt; those premises are unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: FeCoNiMnCu HEA thin films are magnetically soft as-deposited (~10 Oe coercivity)
